name: MatrixMath

members.name: Invert
members.summary: Inverts a matrix using double intermediates with explicit rounding of minors/cofactors. This keeps primary rays stable at triangle boundaries across the math backend migration. Throws for singular matrices or inverses that cannot be represented as finite floats.
